# Phase 1

_________________________________

## Roles:
- SuperAdmin
- Admin
- Provider
- Company
- AlaaEldin

_________________________________

## Service Categories:
- Car_Care
- Personal_Care
- Home_Care

_________________________________

## Supported Languages:
- ar
- en

_________________________________

## Appointment:
### Appointment status flow:
- Pending
- ├─ Accepted
- │  ├─ InProgress
- │  │  └─ Completed
- │  └─ Rescheduled
- │
- ├─ Rejected
- └─ Cancelled
- └─ NoShow

### Appointment Permissions:
- Accepted: Partner only
- InProgress: Partner only
- Rejected: Partner only
- Rescheduled: Customer only
- Completed: Customer only
- Cancelled: Customer only

### Appointment Final statuses:
- Completed
- Rejected
- Cancelled
- NoShow

Once an appointment reaches a final status, it cannot be changed.

_________________________________

## Package Subscription:

### Package Subscription Status Flow:

- Pending
  - Accepted
    - InProgress
      - Completed
- Rejected
- Cancelled
- Failed

### Package Subscription Permissions:

- Accepted: Partner only (create the first occurrence)
- InProgress: Automatically set when at least one occurrence is completed.
- Completed: Automatically set when all occurrences are completed.
- Rejected: Partner only (before accepting).
- Cancelled: Customer only (before accepting).

- Failed: Automatically set when NoShow occurrences exceed 60% of total occurrences.

### Package Subscription Final Statuses:

- Completed
- Rejected
- Cancelled
- Failed

Once a Package Subscription reaches a final status, its status cannot be changed.

_________________________________
## Occurrences Status Flow:

### Occurrences Status Flow:

- Pending
   - InProgress
       - Completed
- NoShow

### Occurrences Permissions:

- Completed: customer only.

### Occurrences Final Statuses:

- Completed
- NoShow

Once a Occurrence reaches a final status, its status cannot be changed.

_________________________________
